_comment: File module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_sandbox_note: ALL file operations are restricted to the Agent's designated sandbox directory. Paths outside the sandbox are rejected by the Agent.

fs_list._desc: List files and folders inside a sandbox path

fs_get._desc: Download a file from the agent's sandbox

fs_put._desc: Upload a file to the agent's sandbox. File content is sent in base64 chunks or as a binary follow-up (TODO: confirm with team which encoding to use).

fs_list_result._desc: Directory listing returned by the agent

fs_get_result._desc: File content returned by the agent (base64 encoded). For large files, may be chunked.

fs_put_result._desc: Agent acknowledges receipt of an upload chunk

fs_put_complete._desc: Agent confirms the full file has been received and saved

fs_error._desc: Agent reports a file operation error (path outside sandbox, permission denied, etc.)
